Team —

I need a quick exec path for NOVA Therapeutics (deal DL-2026-1789). They are asking for three concessions to close this quarter:

1) Include the Premium Onboarding bundle (4-week concierge + 2 dedicated trainers) at no additional PS charge for year 1 (this normally costs $45k).
2) A one-time 30% discount on hosted inference usage for the first 12 months (applied to list pricing).
3) Scope exception: build a custom FHIR-to-Redwood connector (estimated 40 engineer-hrs) outside our standard integration package.

Context: NOVA is a mid-size clinical AI vendor — strong reference potential in oncology — procurement pushed for commercial terms this week. HubSpot deal link and SOW attached.

Ask: I am requesting leadership approval for the bundled premium onboarding inclusion + the usage discount and an exception to absorb the custom connector as a billable credit (or explicit PS line item at reduced rate). If we can get a conditional signoff (finance + legal), procurement will route DocuSign by Thursday.

Attachments: NOVA-SOW-v3.pdf, novatherapeutics-pricing-sheet-202611.xlsx

Thanks — I know this is a larger-than-standard concession so calling it out.

—Marissa Cole

- Connector estimate: NOVA engineer hinted at 60 hrs, but our infra estimates 40 hrs total (incl. 8 hrs QA + 4 hrs handoff doc). I asked Eng to confirm and attached integration-scope-redline.docx with conservative breakdown.

1) Discount scoped to generation tokens only and capped at the projected monthly volume in the attached pricing sheet. Any overage billed at list.
